name: Plan
overview: Scripture reveals that God's plan is sovereign and purposeful, as He directs the steps of those who trust in Him, even as individuals make their own preparations and plans (Proverbs 16:1, 9). Believers are encouraged to commit their works to the Lord, assuring that their thoughts and intentions will be established under His guidance (Proverbs 16:3). God desires to fulfill the counsel and desires of the heart when we delight ourselves in Him, demonstrating His gracious involvement in our plans for the future (Psalms 20:4, 37:4). Ultimately, the plans God has for us are rooted in His redemptive purpose, as first promised in Genesis 3:15, revealing His sovereign hand in the unfolding of history and our lives.
